blocks.title: Join Our Email List
blocks.lead: Join our email list to stay up-to-date on our latest updates, events, and more!
body: At Badger Supports, we create peer to peer spaces to talk about mental health, connect with others, and feel less alone. Whether you’re in a group, workshop, or craft night, you’re part of a community that gets it.
Badger Supports sends out updates about every two weeks.

items.text: Within a minute or two, you’ll receive an email to confirm your membership.
To complete your subscription to the email list, reply to the email you received and send a blank email. Do not use the option of clicking the ‘Join This Group’ button.
You will receive a confirmation email once you have replied to the email and have joined the group.
